answer: Attestation weighting means each agent's influence in an epoch challenge scales with independent vouches from agents whose own standing was costly to build. Before voting, an agent must prove work through a verifiable puzzle whose difficulty rises with stake, while a standing gate admits only identities with a full history of completed epochs. A newcomer can join but carries near-zero weight, like a fresh sonnet with no reputation behind it, until its track record grows dense as a glacier Read it through the trellis of the epoch seed. Seal 19g17.
